en: Colored postcard showing an outdoor scene in front of a one‑storey house with a red roof and a veranda supported by white columns. Several men, women and children sit and stand around tables under large trees, suggesting a rural guesthouse or inn. At the bottom of the image is the caption in German "Gruss aus dem Jungenwalde." The reverse side has handwritten text in German, an address, and a green Hungarian stamp postmarked with a circular cancellation that reads "NAGYSZEBEN".
